<!-- pr-reviewer: 0360d69cdbecaef73dd69bc9f14cfcc4ea08416a -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

What looks good
- `lay_part_on_face` runs `AlignPartToSetup::lay_on_plane` through `env.history`: one undoable step, the command's refusals returned by name, no unwrap/expect/panic on the path. Errors come from `?`/`map_err`.
- No new refusal is loosened; the tool only forwards to the existing command.
- Test in `crates/app/tests/mcp_lay_face.rs` imports `camcraft_app` and has a Gate map; it covers landing, undo/redo and each refusal.
- Decision file `docs/decisions/729-lay-part-on-face.md` present; no new crate dependency; `align_tools.rs` is 194 lines; no snapshot or golden changes.
- Process files touched (camcraft-mcp skill row): PROCESS_VERSION is 47, main is 46. Correct bump.
- Body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #729`; effort medium fits an MCP tool over an existing command.

Local results (clean trial merge with main, "Already up to date")
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_lay_face`: 1 passed
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_setup`: 8 passed
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean

Requested before merge: none.

Notes (not blocking)
- This does not change what the command computes, so the safety floor is not engaged; it exposes existing, already-refusing logic.
- Curved-face refusal over MCP is untested here (noted in the body); pinned at command level.
- UI change: none, so no screenshots needed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
